flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/repccs/notice_creation/core (RepccsCreateNoticeController, CreateNoticeServiceImpl, helpers/AdvisoryNoticeHelper, NoticeProcessingHelper, NoticeRecordHelper, ValidationServices, RepWebHookPayloadValidator) and the copy in ocmsadminapi workflows/notice_creation/core (CreateNoticeController /repccsWebhook-create-notice, CreateNoticeServiceImpl, AdvisoryNoticeHelper). The later AN flow: framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob. There is no code that converts an AN to a NOPO
note: Status 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)'. The story asks OCMS to check for a manual AN created in the backend for the same vehicle when it processes a REPCCS AN, and then convert it to a NOPO. The code receives the REPCCS webhook (ocmsadminprivateapi /repccsWebhook and the ocmsadminapi copy /repccsWebhook-create-notice), validates ANSFlag Y/N, then runs the AN qualification check (offence type O, vehicle type S/D/V/I, exemption rules, 24-month past offences). But there is no detection of a 'manual AN from the backend' and no AN to NOPO conversion: when the AN check fails, the an_flag from the REPCCS payload stays Y and is written on INSERT; the only place that sets an_flag N is for the same vehicle within one batch. A synonym search (manual AN, existingAn, convert, AN_TO_NOPO, an_flag) in ocmsadminapi and ocmsadminprivateapi/src found no conversion logic. The two tiers hold nearly the same logic; which tier REPCCS calls through APIM cannot verify from repo. Appendix B of Annex 1A is not in the repo. The demo remark (Vault code split, Vault permission for the App Service) cannot verify from repo. No maintenance ticket changes the verdict. The folder ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice/ is stale and not used.
recommendation: Do not claim in full. What exists: receiving the REPCCS AN and the AN qualification check. What is missing: detection of a manual backend AN for the same vehicle and the conversion to NOPO (the code keeps the an_flag Y from REPCCS). Ask URA to confirm the conversion rule and provide Appendix B of Annex 1A.

steps.step: OCMS receives the AN issued by REPCCS through the webhook and validates it
steps.detail: POST /repccsWebhook (RepccsCreateNoticeController.java:39-44) calls processRepccsCreateNotice (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:99): save the audit, check the subscription key (110), validate the mandatory fields including ANSFlag that must be Y or N (RepWebHookPayloadValidator.java:169-175), check for a duplicate notice (154), then processNoticeWithDtoMapping (168). The ocmsadminapi copy: CreateNoticeController.java:46-50 -> CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:186. The two tiers hold nearly the same logic; which endpoint is wired in APIM/REPCCS cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: While processing the REPCCS AN, OCMS checks other notices on the same vehicle
steps.detail: The REPCCS subsystem labels 006-010, 020-021, 023 (RepWebHookPayloadValidator.java:206-211 in ocmsadminapi) are below 030, so they are not the EHT/CERTIS path and enter the OCMS-side AN check (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:829-852; ocmsadminapi copy CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:1160-1185). checkQualification requires offence type O and vehicle type S/D/V/I (AdvisoryNoticeHelper.java:99-106), then checkPastOffences loads all notices with the same vehicle_no within 24 months (192-206) and drops the notice being processed (210-214). This is a general lookup over all notices of the vehicle, not a search specific to a manual AN created in the backend: there is no filter on an_flag, notice source (staff or REPCCS) or creator. The check is skipped for the EHT/CERTIS subsystem (labels 030-999).

steps.step: OCMS detects a manual AN created in the backend for the same vehicle
steps.detail: No code was found that looks for a staff-created notice with an_flag='Y' on the same vehicle_no. The only lookup is the 24-month past-offence check in the previous step: when an old notice is not PS with an ANS_PS_REASON reason, the result is only 'not qualified' (AdvisoryNoticeHelper.java:238-255), not 'manual AN found'. PS-ANS is only applied after the eAN is sent (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:398-407), so a manual AN that was not sent yet does not show up as an AN. A search with the synonyms manual AN, existingAn, an_flag, AN_TO_NOPO, convert in ocmsadminapi and ocmsadminprivateapi/src (excluding the stale cronservice/ folder) found no such logic. The contents of ANS_PS_REASON in ocms_standard_code cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: If one exists, OCMS converts the REPCCS AN into a NOPO
steps.detail: There is no conversion. When the AN check is not qualified, setAnQualificationFlags does nothing (NoticeProcessingHelper.java:124-146, empty else branch), while the an_flag from the REPCCS ANSFlag is already in the dto (ValidationServices.java:126). NoticeRecordHelper.applyPreSetAnFlags then writes an_flag='Y' and payment_acceptance_allowed NOT_ALLOWED on INSERT (NoticeRecordHelper.java:591-598). So the REPCCS AN stays an AN even when OCMS judges it not qualified (when the payload has ANSFlag=Y). The only place that sets an_flag='N' is the branch 'vehicle already AN-qualified in the same batch' (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:837-841); the anQualifiedVehicles tracker is created fresh per request (432) and the REPCCS webhook sends one notice per request, so this branch does not catch a manual AN that is already in the DB. [Medium confidence: read from the code flow, not executed]. The ocmsadminapi copy is the same (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:1168-1170; NoticeRecordHelper.java:591-598).

steps.step: The converted notice is processed as a NOPO according to the automated processing workflow in Appendix B
steps.detail: A non-AN notice from REPCCS of type V/S/D follows the normal automated flow: payment_acceptance_allowed Y, last stage NPA, next stage ROV (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:819; NoticeProcessingHelper.java:423-441), then it is picked up by the LTA Upload cron (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:61-77). This path exists and is generic, but because the previous step has no conversion, no REPCCS notice enters the NOPO path as a result of detecting a manual AN. The content of Appendix B of Annex 1A is not in the repo (cannot verify from repo).
